touch_explainer.lay:
**FLY** (left): push to steer, push up to flap.
**DIVE** (right): tap to dive, drag to aim the dive.

crash.default: Pull up, you daft gull! Hold {flap}!
crash.realistic: Pull up, you daft gull! Tap {flap} fast!
crash.touch: Pull up, you daft gull! Push FLY up!

peck_now.casual: Auto peck is on. Fly into it!

live.missed: Missed! Pull up and dive again
live.first_miss: First miss is normal! Scoop it off the floor later
live.wheelie_low: Too low, gullster. Land on the lid.
live.bin_closer: Closer, gullster! Land right beside the bin.
live.too_steep: Crash likely, reposition or pull up quickly
live.mug_miss: Missed! Fly up and dive against him again.
live.mug_rescue: He's holding still for you. Fly up and dive against him.

aim_freeze.default:
Aim with {steer} and line up the snack.
Press {dive} to start dive.
aim_freeze.touch:
Aim with {steer} and line up the snack.
Tap DIVE to start dive.

dive_nudge.touch: Climb above him, then tap DIVE

toddler_peck.default: Tap {peck_alt} to peck his ice cream!
toddler_peck.touch: Tap {peck_alt} to peck his ice cream!

live.toddler_pickup: Walk over the ice cream to eat it.
live.full_stomach: Finish your snack first, greedy guts.
live.practice: Pause, then level select, to progress

tips.wheelie_low: TOO LOW! LAND ON THE BIN LID
tips.bin_closer: CLOSER! LAND RIGHT BESIDE THE BIN

score_ways.text: THE PROPER WAY. DIVE THEN PECK.

opening.text:
Welcome to the beach, young gullster.
If you want to survive 'n thrive, you got to learn quick. Follow the **golden ring**.

closing.text:
Not bad, gullster. You can swoop, raid bins and nick a cone off a toddler.

Now go fleece that beach.
closing.first_time_text:
Not bad, gullster. You can swoop, raid bins and nick a cone off a toddler.

Here's a feather for your trouble.

lay.default: This is the open sand. Nothing here worth nicking, so first things first: get airborne. Gulls fly by flapping and steering.
lay.realistic:
First things first: get airborne.

You picked Realistic mode, so every wingbeat is a separate tap.

how.default: Hold {flap} to flap and climb. Steer with {steer} to head right. Fly through the golden ring.
how.realistic: Tap {flap} over and over to climb, about four or five taps a second. Steer with {steer} to head right. Fly through the golden ring.
how.touch: Push FLY up to flap and climb. Steer with {steer} to head right. Fly through the golden ring.

strip.default: Hold {flap} to take off, then steer right
strip.realistic: Tap {flap} to take off, then steer right
strip.touch: Push FLY up to take off, then steer right

lessons.strip_steer: Steer right with {steer} to the ring

banner.default:
Hold {flap} to flap and climb.
Fly right through the golden ring.
banner.realistic:
Tap {flap} over and over to climb.
Fly right through the golden ring.
banner.touch:
Push FLY up to flap and climb.
Fly right through the golden ring.

lessons.banner_steer:
Now steer right with {steer}.
Fly through the golden ring.

lessons.lay: What goes up must come down, mate. Stop flapping and you glide, and gliding means sinking. Golden crumbs on the sand are free grub.

how.default: Let go of {flap}, aim down and land. Then walk over a golden crumb to eat it.
how.realistic: Stop tapping {flap}, aim down and land. Then walk over a golden crumb to eat it.
how.touch: Stop pushing FLY up, aim down and land. Then walk over a golden crumb to eat it.

strip.default: Let go of {flap}, aim down and land
strip.realistic: Stop tapping {flap}, aim down and land
strip.touch: Stop pushing FLY up, aim down and land

banner.default:
Let go of {flap}, aim down and land.
Then walk over a golden crumb.
banner.realistic:
Stop tapping {flap}, aim down and land.
Then walk over a golden crumb.
banner.touch:
Stop pushing FLY up, aim down and land.
Then walk over a golden crumb.

lessons.lay: Now let's try something as easy as stealing candy from a baby...

how.default: Walk up to the toddler, face his ice cream and tap {peck_alt}.
how.touch: Walk up to the toddler, face his ice cream and tap {peck_alt}.

strip.default: Walk up to the toddler and tap {peck_alt} at his ice cream
strip.touch: Walk up to the toddler and tap {peck_alt} at his ice cream

lessons.how: Land by the bin and tap {peck} {n} times.
lessons.strip: Land by the bin and tap {peck} {n} times

lessons.lay: Now let's get you a proper challenge. See the fella with the ice cream? That's yours...

how.default:
Fly towards your target and get ready to dive.

Press {dive} to dive and get ready to tap {peck}!
how.casual: Fly towards your target and get ready to dive. Press {dive} to dive. Easy mode does the pecking, so just fly your beak into the cone!
how.touch:
Fly towards your target and get ready to dive.

Tap DIVE to dive and get ready to tap {peck}!
how.touch_casual: Fly towards your target and get ready to dive. Tap DIVE to dive. Easy mode does the pecking, so just fly your beak into the cone!

strip.default: Aim at the snack, {dive} to dive, then tap {peck}
strip.casual: Dive with {dive}, your beak pecks for you
strip.touch: Aim at the snack, tap DIVE, then tap {peck}
strip.touch_casual: Tap DIVE, your beak pecks for you

strips: Hold {peck} to screech. Higher is louder
Brash is full! Screech again or press {call}

strips.default: Fly up and dive against the dummy
strips.touch: Fly up and tap DIVE against the dummy

lay.default: Level two, new trick. Every gull has a special, and yours is the GANG CALL. Screech to fill your Brash meter up top. Snatches, mugs and bumps fill it too. Get stunned and it drains.
lay.great-black-backed: Level two, new trick. Every gull has a special, and yours is the SHAKEDOWN. Screech to fill your Brash meter up top. Bumps and mugs fill it fast. Get stunned and it drains.
lay.kittiwake: Level two, new trick. Every gull has a special, and yours is the LIGHTNING STRIKE. Screech to fill your Brash meter up top. Snatches fill it too. Get stunned and it drains.

lessons.how: Hold {peck} to screech until Brash says READY.

lay.default: Now call the cavalry and watch them run!
lay.great-black-backed: Now shake 'em down. Nobody stuns you for a bit.

how.default: Screech again, or press {call}, to call the gang.
how.great-black-backed: Screech again, or press {call}, to start the Shakedown.
how.kittiwake: Screech again, or press {call}, to strike.

lessons.lay: One more trick. This dummy's nicked a snack. Time to mug him...

how.default: Fly up and dive ({dive}) into the rival to steal his snack.
how.touch: Fly up and tap DIVE into the rival to steal his snack.

outro.default: That's the Gang Call! Training grabs don't count. Clock's on!
outro.great-black-backed: That's the Shakedown! Training grabs don't count. Clock's on!
outro.kittiwake: That's the Lightning Strike! Training grabs don't count. Clock's on!

FOOD ON THE COUNTER!
DIVE, THEN PECK IT
counter_tip.casual:
FOOD ON THE COUNTER!
DIVE RIGHT AT IT
counter_tip.touch:
FOOD ON THE COUNTER!
TAP DIVE, THEN PECK
counter_tip.touch_casual:
FOOD ON THE COUNTER!
TAP DIVE AT IT
